analysis.title: Daily Tech Index
key_insights: S&P 500 daily chart: while 7580 holds as resistance, the desk targets 7505 and then 7460. A break above 7580 would trigger a rebound toward 7620 and 7695.
DAX daily chart: while 26,105 holds as resistance, the desk targets 25,810 and then 25,740. A break above 26,105 would trigger an up-move toward 26,165 and 26,250.

EuroStoxx50 daily chart: while 6200 holds as resistance, the desk targets 6145 and then the 200 DMA at 6110. A break above 6200 would breach the downtrend and trigger a rebound toward 6230 and the 50 DMA at 6265.
SMI daily chart: while 14,860 holds as resistance, the desk targets 14,775 and then 14,655. A break above 14,860 would trigger an up-move toward 14,885 and 14,930.

Trend calls are mixed across horizons. The S&P 500 is down on both intraday (below 7580) and 2-5 day (below 7695) views. EuroStoxx50 is down on both. DAX and SMI are down intraday but up on the 2-5 day view (above 25,575 and 14,605 respectively).
